Our story began in Beijing, and its next chapter unfolded in Belgium. Along the way, we completed our studies in Antwerp and Leuven, and before we knew it, we'd been living together for four years! Here you'll find our graduation gifts and a few memories of Beijing.

And finally, we've prepared a little surprise for you… 🎁
